People Ops: Quick update — SRE Capacity team is reorganizing to split 'Capacity' and 'Runtime' responsibilities. Samir will move to lead Capacity starting Apr 6, and we'll backfill his previous runtime responsibilities. We're opening two Senior SRE IC roles and one Staff SRE (Runtime lead). Hiring link and recruiter info below. Please join me in welcoming Asha Patel who starts as Senior SRE (Capacity) on Apr 6! :tada:
Samir Gupta: Huge thanks — glad to have Asha. We'll map owners for autoscaler, batching, and KV cache. Weekly sync Tuesdays 10am; first one Apr 8.
Asha Patel: Thrilled to join — excited to dig into autoscaler perf and batching. Happy to pair on onboarding/checklists this week.
Miguel Santos: Congrats all. This split should help with latency SLOs and reduce cross-team pager noise. If you own dashboards or runbooks that touch Capacity, please flag them in the hiring doc.
Priya Natarajan (Talent): Hiring link: https://redwood.careers/req/REQ-5421 — please send referrals. Panel + rubric posted in #eng-recruiting.
Priya Natarajan (Talent): Quick note: interview loop = takehome or coding + infra design + small perf puzzle. Target timeline: screen -> onsites in 3–4 weeks, offers mid-May.
Samir Gupta: Plan: post req today, run first screens next week. We'll try a canary hire for Runtime if capacity makes sense. Recruiter is Priya.
People Ops: On comp bands — these roles map to Eng IC Band 4–5. If managers need an exception for a senior hire, DM People Ops with a one-line justification.
Asha Patel: Quick Q — who owns private infra access and KMS for Capacity? cc @Miguel Santos
Miguel Santos: I'll take a look and hand off access this afternoon. Samir/Asha let's sync 1:30pm PT. :thumbsup:
people-ops-bot: New hire Asha Patel added to #sre-capacity and onboarding tasks created (TASK-783, TASK-784).
Samir Gupta: Thanks everyone — excited to get this moving. If folks have cross-team dependencies, drop them here or add to the hiring doc. :rocket:
